assumptions: Text prerequisites/effects are exported as source text rather than falsely presented as fully machine-executable semantics.
Loot weights are parsed from Implementation table; quantity bands Easy8–15/Medium12–20/Hard18–28/Extreme24–36 are documented uniform integers. Food/Water split50/50; one choice per roll.
Tutorial balances include stored plus Return Inbox entitlement; not all entitlement is immediately spendable.
Resource-site base_output excludes tier, staffing, integrity, ownership and control multipliers; systems engine must apply documented factors explicitly.
